x-changelog.summary: Filter observations assignees endpoint by Observation Category
x-changelog.description:
Updated the observations assignees endpoint to accept an optional `filters[category_id]` parameter. Where
advanced Observations permissions are in use, the endpoint now returns only the users who can be assigned
an Observation in that category. When the parameter is omitted, it returns the users who can be assigned
in at least one category the logged-in user can create an Observation in.

x-changelog.summary: Update observations assignees endpoint to support granular permissions
x-changelog.description:
Updated the observations assignees endpoint to return users based on granular permissions. The endpoint now respects
"Can be Assigned as Observation Assignee" and "Assign Observations to Users in the Same Company" granular
permissions, allowing read-only users with the appropriate granular permissions to be included in the
assignable users list.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
This is a **0-based index** representing the page slice of the data you want to retrieve. Each page contains up to **400 items**.
### **📌 Pageable Endpoints** People endpoints that return multiple records **support pagination**. It is recommended to use this feature to prevent network timeouts from excessively large data requests.
### **📌 Response Structure** A successful response will include the following properties:
- **`possible_pages`** *(integer)* → Total number of pages available to retrieve all data. - **`current_page`** *(integer)* → The **0-based index** of the page retrieved. - **`data`** *(array)* → List of records returned for the requested page (up to 400 items per page).
If a **page value exceeds** `possible_pages`, the `data` property will return an **empty array**.

parameters.description: Filters items updated on or after the specified date (inclusive). Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

schema.description: Request body schema for creating a new Person.

is_user.description: Determines if the Person can log into the app.

is_assignable.description: Determines if the Person can be assigned to tasks.

status.description: The status of the Person. `active` means the person is visible in all pages, while `inactive` hides the person unless filtered. Inactive People do not count against billing plans.

group_ids.description: Array of UUIDs representing the Groups this Person belongs to. Can be empty if the Person is an Admin.

email.description: The email that the Person will log in with. Required if `is_user` is true.

permission_level_id.description: UUID of the Permission Level assigned to the Person.

no_invite.description: If `true`, the Person will be created with all user properties but will not receive an invite until triggered manually by an Admin.

password.description: Password for logging in. If not provided, an email will be sent to the user to set their password. Must be at least 8 characters with one uppercase, one lowercase, and one number.

notification_profile_id.description: UUID of the Notification Profile for the user.

phone.description: The Person's phone number, including country and area code. Must be unique among all registered People. **Note:** Pass `null` or exclude the field if the Person should not have a phone number.

can_receive_sms.description: Determines if the Person can receive SMS notifications.

can_receive_email.description: Determines if the Person can receive email notifications.

can_receive_mobile.description: Determines if the Person can receive mobile push notifications if they have the app installed.

address_1.description: First part of the Person's address.

address_2.description: Second part of the Person's address (e.g., Apartment, Suite, Unit).

city_town.description: The city or town where the Person is located.

state_province.description: The state or province where the Person is located.

zipcode.description: The postal/zip code of the Person.

country.description: The country where the Person is located.

job_title_id.description: UUID reference to a Job Title in the LaborChart System.

hourly_wage.description: Hourly wage rate for the Person. Used for automatic spend tracking.

emergency_contact_name.description: Name of the Person's emergency contact.

emergency_contact_number.description: Phone number of the emergency contact.

emergency_contact_email.description: Email address of the emergency contact.

emergency_contact_relation.description: The relationship between the Person and their emergency contact.

dob.description: Date of birth of the Person. Accepts ISO Date String, UTC Date String, or MS Numeric Epoch Time.

hired_date.description: Date the Person was hired. Accepts ISO Date String, UTC Date String, or MS Numeric Epoch Time.

is_male.description: Specifies if the Person identifies as male.

language.description: Language preference. Currently only `english` is supported.

tag_instances.description: List of tags applied to the Person. Tags can require expiration dates.

expr_date.description: Expiration date for the Tag, if applicable.

schema.description: Response schema containing a unique identifier.

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
This is a **0-based index** representing the page slice of the data you want to retrieve. Each page contains up to **400 items**.
### **📌 Pageable Endpoints** People endpoints that return multiple records **support pagination**. It is recommended to use this feature to prevent network timeouts from excessively large data requests.
### **📌 Response Structure** A successful response will include the following properties:
- **`possible_pages`** *(integer)* → Total number of pages available to retrieve all data. - **`current_page`** *(integer)* → The **0-based index** of the page retrieved. - **`data`** *(array)* → List of records returned for the requested page (up to 400 items per page).
If a **page value exceeds** `possible_pages`, the `data` property will return an **empty array**.

get.description:
Return a list of all Potential Change Order Line Items.

Change Event Line Item information is only returned if a line item is associated to a change event line item and user can view change events.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

Note: A v2.0 version of this endpoint is available and recommended for new integrations. Use the v2.0 change order line items endpoints, depending on the change order type: GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/prime_change_orders/{prime_change_order_id}/line_items or GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/commitment_change_orders/{commitment_change_order_id}/line_items.

post.summary: Create Potential Change Order Line Item

Create a Potential Change Order Line Item.
Note: For non-budgeted line items, a corresponding budget line item may be created automatically.

project_id.description: Unique identifier for the project.

amount.description: Total amount for this line item, as a decimal string. When extended_type is "calculated", this is derived from quantity multiplied by unit_cost. When extended_type is "manual", this value is set directly and takes precedence over unit_cost and quantity.

cost_code_id.description: ID of the Cost Code this line item is charged against. Must belong to the project's cost code list.

description.description: Free-text description of the work or item this line covers.

extended_type.description: How the line item amount is derived. Use "calculated" to compute amount from quantity and unit cost, or "manual" to set the amount directly.

quantity.description: Number of units for this line item, as a decimal string.

line_item_type_id.description: ID of the Line Item Type (cost classification such as labor, material, or equipment) applied to this line item.

origin_data.description: Free-form metadata from an external system, stored to help correlate this line item with its source record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this line item in the external system it was imported from. Use to match records during integrations.

tax_code_id.description: ID of the Tax Code applied to this line item, if any.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit, as a decimal string. Multiplied by quantity to compute amount when extended_type is "calculated".

uom.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. Must be a unit present in the company's Units of Measure list. On update, send null or an empty string to clear the unit of measure.
enum: Any value present in the Company list of Units of Measure

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code this line item is assigned to.

patch.description:
This endpoint creates or updates a batch of Potential Change Orders (PCO).
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: ID of the contract (prime or commitment) whose potential change orders this request targets.

change_order_request_id.description: ID of the Change Order Request (COR) this PCO belongs to. Used on multi-tier contract configurations to group the PCO under a request.

change_order_package_id.description: ID of the Change Order Package the PCO's Change Order Request is assigned to. Applies to two-tier contract configurations.

commitment_change_event_id.description: ID of the commitment Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a commitment.

description.description: Free-text description of the scope of this change order.

due_date.description: Date by which the change order is due, in ISO 8601 format.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

number.description: Human-readable change order number, unique within the contract.

origin_data.description: Free-form metadata from an external system, stored to correlate this PCO with its source record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this PCO in the external system it was imported from. Use to match records during integrations.

paid_date.description: Date the change order was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

prime_change_event_id.description: ID of the prime contract Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a prime contract.

schedule_impact_amount.description: Estimated impact of this change order on the project schedule, in days.

status.description: Workflow status of the change order. Ignored on projects where the tool is configured for single-tier change orders.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order.

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate used to convert from the change order's currency to the project's currency. Accepted only on projects where multicurrency conversion is available.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Potential Change Order. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete it.

accounting_method.description: How the change order is priced: "amount" for a lump-sum total or "unit" for quantity-times-unit-cost line items.

change_order_change_reason_id.description: ID of the change reason assigned to this PCO, if change reasons are enabled for the project.

change_order_request_id.description: ID of the Change Order Request (COR) this PCO belongs to, on multi-tier contract configurations.

commitment_change_event_id.description: ID of the commitment Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a commitment.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null for active PCOs.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"updates\":[{\"change_order_request_id\":56490,\"change_order_request\":{\"change_order_package_id\":875689},\"commitment_change_event_id\":135314,\"description\":\"Freezer slab replacement\",\"due_date\":\"2017-08-19T21:39:40Z\",\"invoiced_date\":\"2017-08-19\",\"number\":\"C34\",\"origin_data\":\"OD-2398273424\",\"origin_id\":\"459247544\",\"paid_date\":\"2017-08-18\",\"prime_change_event_id\":135314,\"schedule_impact_amount\":2,\"status\":\"draft\",\"title\":\"Concrete freezer slab\",\"currency_exchange_rate\":\"20.0\"}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/potential_change_orders/sync?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&contract_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

get.description:
Return a list of all Potential Change Orders (PCO).

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[origin_id]
parameters.description: Origin ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Origin ID.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[due_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) due within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[contract_id]
parameters.description: Contract ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Contract ID.

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description: Use 'only' for only deleted resources. Use 'with' for deleted and undeleted resources.

parameters.name: filters[invoiced_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) invoiced within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[paid_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) paid within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[reviewed_at]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) reviewed within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

post.summary: Create Prime Change Order Line Item
post.description: Creates a line item for a given prime change order.

parameters.name: prime_change_order_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Prime Change Order. See `GET /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/prime_change_orders`.

prime_line_item_id.description: ID of the prime contract line item associated with this line item. Pass null when updating to remove the association.

rate_value_id.description: ID of the project rate value selected for this line item. Accepted only for unit-quantity schedules of values. Pass null when updating to clear the selected rate.

resource_id.description: ID of the resource assigned to this line item. When provided with a rate value, the resource must match the resource associated with that rate. Accepted only for unit-quantity schedules of values. Pass null when updating to clear the assigned resource.

amount.description: Amount - this field is nullable on unit quantity SOVs but NOT amount-based SOVs. For line item creates, if this field is omitted on unit quantity SOVs,  the amount will be calculated as quantity * unit_cost. For line item updates, if a null amount is passed in on unit quantity SOVs, it will set the line item extended type to "calculated".

quantity.description: Quantity - only accepted on unit quantity SOVs

unit_cost.description: Unit cost - only accepted on unit quantity SOVs

uom.description: Unit of measure - only accepted on unit quantity SOVs. For line item updates, pass null or an empty string to clear the unit of measure.
enum: Any value present in the Company list of Units of Measure

wbs_code_id.description: WBS code ID

funding_rule_id.description: ID of the funding rule associated with this line item. Funding Sources must be enabled at the project level. The rule must be ACTIVE and its currency must match the contract currency. Pass null to disassociate an existing funding rule.

data.title: Line Item Row
data.description: A row on a schedule of values.

prime_line_item_id.description: ID of the prime contract line item associated with this line item

funding_rule_id.description: ID of the funding rule associated with this line item

resource.description: Rate and resource selection associated with a line item.

rate_value_id.description: ID of the selected rate value. Null when the line item uses a manually entered rate.

currency_iso_code.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the selected or manually entered rate.

resource_category.description: Category used to classify the selected labor, equipment, or other resource. Null when no resource is assigned.

resource_id.description: ID of the resource assigned to the line item. Null when no resource is assigned.

resource_name.description: Display name of the resource assigned to the line item. Null when no resource is assigned.

`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[cost_code_id]
parameters.description: Cost Code ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Cost Code ID or within the specified range of Cost Code IDs.

parameters.name: filters[line_item_type_id]
parameters.description: Line Item Type ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Line Item Type ID or range of Line Item Type IDs.

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

schema.description: Array of line items

items.title: default
items.description: Line Item (when the 'default' view is requested)

id.description: Unique identifier of the line item. Use as the {id} path parameter to show, update, or delete this line item.

amount.description: Bottom-line monetary amount for the line item, as a decimal string in the contract's currency.

company.description: Company that owns the project this Line Item belongs to.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Cost Code record.

biller.description: Display name of the entity (project or sub job) that owns this cost code.

biller_id.description: Procore ID of the owning project or sub job. Use with biller_type to identify the owning entity.

biller_type.description: Type of entity that owns this cost code. One of: 'Project' (a standard project) or 'SubJob' (a sub job within the project).

biller_origin_id.description: ERP origin ID of the owning project or sub job. Null when no ERP origin has been set.

budgeted.description: Whether this cost code has been marked as budgeted. True when at least one budget line item exists for this cost code.

code.description: Cost code segment, not including the parent prefix. For example, for full code "02-300", this field is "300".

created_at.description: Timestamp when this cost code was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this cost code was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the record is active.

full_code.description: Full cost code including all parent prefixes (e.g. "02-300").

name.description: Display name of the cost code.

origin_data.description: Free-form third-party metadata string from the ERP system. Null when no ERP origin data has been set.

origin_id.description: ERP system identifier for this cost code. Used by sync operations to match records across systems.

parent.description: The immediate parent cost code of this record, if any.

id.description: Procore ID of this cost code's parent cost code. Null for root-level cost codes.

position.description: Sort order of this cost code within its parent.

sortable_code.description: Deprecated alias for full_code. Use full_code instead. Included for backwards compatibility.

standard_cost_code_id.description: ID of the company-level standard cost code that this project cost code was created from. Null when not derived from a standard list.

standard_cost_code_list_id.description: ID of the company-level standard cost code list associated with this cost code via its standard cost code. Null when not linked to a standard list. Only present in the extended view.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this cost code was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

line_item_types.description: Array of line item types (cost types) assigned to this cost code. Each entry represents one Cost Code / Line Item Type assignment.

items.title: LineItemType
items.description: A line item type assigned to this cost code.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Line Item Type.

name.description: Display name of the Line Item Type.

code.description: Short code used for CSV import of this Line Item Type.

base_type.description: Canonical cost category for this line item type. One of: 'equipment', 'materials', 'commitment', 'owner_cost', 'professional_services', 'labor', 'other'.

origin_id.description: ERP system identifier for this line item type. Null when not linked to an ERP system.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this Line Item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

post.description: Creates a new Prime Contract for a given project.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies which view (which attributes) of the resource is going to be present in the response. The default view returns the full contract attributes. The extended view additionally includes architect name, contractor name, vendor name, and custom field data. The ids_only view (List endpoint only) returns just the contract `id` for each record, for lightweight ID retrieval.

number.description: The Prime Contract number. Defaults to the project numbering sequence for the respective contract type.

status.description: The Prime Contract status.

executed.description: The Prime Contract executed status.

vendor_id.description: The ID of the vendor for the contract. The selected invoice contacts must all belong to this vendor. When the vendor is changed, the invoice contacts are reset.

parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a Prime Contract for a given project.

parameters.name: prime_contract_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Prime Contract.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies which view (which attributes) of the resource is going to be present in the response. The default view returns the full contract attributes. The extended view additionally includes architect name, contractor name, vendor name, and custom field data. The ids_only view (List endpoint only) returns just the contract `id` for each record, for lightweight ID retrieval.

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description: Use 'only' to return only deleted resources. Use 'with' to return deleted and undeleted resources.

id.description: Stringified unique identifier for the Prime Contract. Pass as the {prime_contract_id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete this contract.

type.description: Contract subtype discriminator. Always `PrimeContract` for this resource.

number.description: The Prime Contract number, unique within the project's numbering sequence for this contract type.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the Prime Contract (e.g. Draft, Approved, Complete).

executed.description: Whether the contract has been executed (fully signed and in effect).

title.description: Human-readable title of the Prime Contract.

description.description: Rich-text (HTML) description of the Prime Contract.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Prime Contract was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Prime Contract was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

grand_total.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. It should be assumed that this number includes arbitrary precision and scale, however, the API may not store or process the number with infinite precision and scale.

private.description: When private, a contract is only visible to the creator and the assigned accessors.

base_currency_iso_code.description: Base Currency ISO Code configured from project level; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity

currency_exchange_rate.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. allow_markups.description: Whether markups are allowed on the Prime Contract.

parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Prime Contract.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies which view (which attributes) of the resource is going to be present in the response. The default view returns the full contract attributes. The extended view additionally includes architect name, contractor name, vendor name, and custom field data. The ids_only view (List endpoint only) returns just the contract `id` for each record, for lightweight ID retrieval.

number.description: The Prime Contract number. Defaults to the project numbering sequence for the respective contract type.

status.description: The Prime Contract status.

executed.description: The Prime Contract executed status.

vendor_id.description: The ID of the vendor for the contract. The selected invoice contacts must all belong to this vendor. When the vendor is changed, the invoice contacts are reset.

architect_id.description: The ID of the architect for the contract.

contractor_id.description: The ID of the contractor for the contract.

inclusions.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts. The inclusions of the Prime Contract.

exclusions.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts. The exclusions of the Prime Contract.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method for the contract. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_comments.description: If true, comments are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise comments are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

auto_approve_prefilled_requisitions_on_p.description: If true, prefilled requisitions are auto-approved on payment applications; otherwise prefilled requisitions are not auto-approved. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_markups.description: If true, markups are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise markups are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

change_order_level_of_detail.description: The level of details for showing change orders on invoices attached to this contract.

enable_ssov.description: If true, the subcontractor schedule of values (SSOV) is enabled for the Prime Contract; otherwise the SSOV is not enabled. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_payment_applications.description: If true, invoices are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise invoices are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_payments.description: If true, payments are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise payments are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

display_materials_retainage.description: If true, materials retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract; otherwise materials retainage is not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

display_work_retainage.description: If true, work retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract; otherwise work retainage is not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

show_cost_code_on_pdf.description: If true, cost codes are displayed on the Prime Contract PDF; otherwise cost codes are not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

retainage_percent.description: Default retainage percentage applied to the contract, expressed as a percent (e.g. 5.0 for 5%).

accessor_ids.description: Only applicable to private contracts. IDs of users in the project directory (see the Project Users endpoint). These users will be able to view the commitment contract.

private.description: If true, visible to admins and accessors only; otherwise visible to those with access to the Primes tool. Default based on project level setting.

show_line_items_to_non_admins.description: Only applicable to private contracts. If true, line items are visible to non-admins; otherwise visible to admins only.

signature_required.description: If true, a signature is required to execute the contract; otherwise no signature is required.

actual_completion_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

contract_estimated_completion_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

contract_start_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

contract_termination_date.description: The date the contract was terminated.

substantial_completion_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange Rate from Contract Currency to Project Currency; It'll be accepted only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled and user has the granular permission to edit the contract exchange rate.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO code; It'll be accepted only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled.

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.
For a lov_entry data_type the value passed in should be the ID of one of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries. For a lov_entries data_type the value passed in should be an array of IDs of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries.

change_event_attachment_ids.description: List of attachment IDs to attach. These must presently be associated with Change Events.

attachment_ids.description: The current attachments to the item. Values should be omitted to remove attachments. New files cannot be attached via this param. If the key is omitted, the existing attachments will remain unchanged.

x-changelog.description:
Added new fields to request body and response:
- `enable_public_discovery`: Boolean flag for public bid package discoverability
- `pre_bid_meeting_location`: Location for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_date`: Date and time for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_online_link`: Online meeting link for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_notes`: Notes for the pre-bid meeting
- `public_project_funding_source`: Source of funding for the public project, either 'private' or 'public'
- `show_location_for_nda_projects`: Whether to show location for NDA projects
- `public_bid_opening_details_date`: Date and time for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_location`: Location for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_online_link`: Online link for the public bid opening
- `trades_and_services`: Array of PCN trade classifications with trade_level, trade_path, and trade_key
- `business_classifications`: Array of business classifications with classification_name, classification_abbreviation, and classification_key

Added to response only:
- `primary_slug_with_ids`: Primary public slug with company ID and bid package ID prefix (format: {company_id}_{bid_package_id}_{slug}, auto-generated from title)

x-changelog.summary: Added lock fields for unit and quantity
x-changelog.description:
Added 4 new lock fields to bid packages: lock_unit_fields_base_bid, lock_quantity_fields_base_bid,
lock_unit_fields_alternates, and lock_quantity_fields_alternates. These fields allow solicitors
to set global lock settings for unit and quantity fields.

x-changelog.summary: Separated Pre-Bid Meeting and Public Bid Opening fields into new feature flag
x-changelog.description:
Pre-Bid Meeting and Public Bid Opening fields are now controlled by a separate feature flag (`bidding-show-pre-bid-and-public-opening-fields`), independent from the `show-public-projects` flag.

Fields affected:
- pre_bid_meeting_date
- pre_bid_meeting_location
- pre_bid_meeting_online_link
- pre_bid_meeting_notes
- public_bid_opening_details_date
- public_bid_opening_details_location
- public_bid_opening_details_online_link

These fields can now be set and returned independently of other Public Projects functionality.

Affected endpoints:
- POST /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages
- PATCH /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages/{id}
- GET /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages/{id}
- GET /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages
- POST /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages/{id}/seal

x-changelog.description:
Added two new fields to support project logo display:
- `project_logo_name`: The file name of the project logo (e.g., 'logo.png')
- `project_logo_url`: The URL to access the project logo (e.g., 'http://www.example.com/logo.png'). This will default to the Procore logo if the project does not have a custom logo.

parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore project. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/projects. Identifies which project's currency configuration to act on.

get.description: Returns the currency configuration for the specified project. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated, so consumers can detect the unconfigured state without a 404. When the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company, the response also carries `currency_status`, `confirmed_at`, and `confirmed_by`; these keys are absent, not null, when the feature is off.

schema.title: Project Currency Configuration GET Response
schema.description: Currency configuration for a Procore project. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company-eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated, so consumers can detect the unconfigured state without a 404.

company_id.description: Procore company ID that owns this project. Matches the {company_id} path parameter.

project_id.description: Procore project ID this configuration belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter and is the foreign key to use for all project-scoped multicurrency requests.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the project's currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'). May differ from the company base currency when company-level multicurrency is enabled. Null when no project currency configuration has been created.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered for this project. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD). Null when no project currency configuration has been created.

company_currency_exchange_rate_override.description: Decimal override (sent as a string for precision) that supersedes the company-level exchange rate when converting between the project currency and the company base currency. Null to use the company exchange rate.

currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update.description: Whether the project's `currency_iso_code` can still be changed. Currently always returns true; will reflect exchange-rate / multicurrency-record presence once project exchange-rate APIs are GA.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether multicurrency settings apply to this project's financial objects. Defaults to false. When true, financial objects can use a different currency from the company base. Requires the parent company to also have multicurrency enabled.

eligible_for_financial_objs_multicurrenc.description: Whether the parent company satisfies the prerequisites (e.g., ERP integration compatibility) to apply project-level multicurrency to financial objects. When false, attempts to enable `multicurrency_enabled` on the project will be rejected. Conditionally present — absent from the response for companies that do not have project-level financial-object multicurrency rolled out.

multicurrency_phase_two_flag_enabled.description: Inherited from the parent company. Indicates whether the project has access to the extended multicurrency capabilities (separate base/quote currency tracking and per-record exchange rate fields used by multicurrency-aware downstream resources). When false, the project is limited to baseline multicurrency behavior and attempts to set `multicurrency_enabled=true` on the project are rejected.

currency_status.description: Confirmation lifecycle state of the project currency. `pending` until a user explicitly confirms the currency; `confirmed` afterwards, at which point `currency_iso_code` can no longer be changed. Returns `pending` when no project currency configuration has been created. Conditionally present — absent from the response unless the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company or project.

confirmed_at.description: When the project currency was confirmed. Null while `currency_status` is `pending`. Conditionally present — absent from the response unless the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company or project.

confirmed_by.description: Procore user ID of the user who confirmed the project currency. Null while `currency_status` is `pending`. Conditionally present — absent from the response unless the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company or project.

patch.description: Updates the project's currency configuration. Send only the fields you want to change; omitted fields are left unchanged. `currency_iso_code` can only be updated while `currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update` is true.

currency_iso_code.description:
Optional. ISO 4217 three-letter code for the project's currency (e.g., 'EUR').
Only updatable while `currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update` is true in the GET
response. Returns 400 if an update is attempted when the field is locked.

company_currency_exchange_rate_override.description: Optional decimal override (sent as a string for precision). When set, supersedes the company-level exchange rate when converting between this project's currency and the company base currency. Send null to clear the override and revert to the company rate.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered for this project. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD). Omit to leave unchanged.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether to apply project-level currency settings to this project's financial objects. Requires the parent company to also have multicurrency enabled; otherwise the API returns 400. Omit to leave the existing value unchanged.

schema.title: Project Currency Configuration
schema.description: Currency configuration for a Procore project. Returned after a successful create, update, or delete; all fields reflect the persisted record.

company_id.description: Procore company ID that owns this project. Matches the {company_id} path parameter.

project_id.description: Procore project ID this configuration belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter and is the foreign key to use for all project-scoped multicurrency requests.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the project's currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'). May differ from the company base currency when company-level multicurrency is enabled.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered for this project. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD).

company_currency_exchange_rate_override.description: Decimal override (sent as a string for precision) that supersedes the company-level exchange rate when converting between the project currency and the company base currency. Null to use the company exchange rate.

currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update.description: Whether the project's `currency_iso_code` can still be changed. Currently always returns true; will reflect exchange-rate / multicurrency-record presence once project exchange-rate APIs are GA.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether multicurrency settings apply to this project's financial objects. When true, financial objects can use a different currency from the company base. Requires the parent company to also have multicurrency enabled.

eligible_for_financial_objs_multicurrenc.description: Whether the parent company satisfies the prerequisites (e.g., ERP integration compatibility) to apply project-level multicurrency to financial objects. When false, attempts to enable `multicurrency_enabled` on the project are rejected. Conditionally present — absent from the response for companies that do not have project-level financial-object multicurrency rolled out.

multicurrency_phase_two_flag_enabled.description: Inherited from the parent company. Indicates whether the project has access to the extended multicurrency capabilities (separate base/quote currency tracking and per-record exchange rate fields used by multicurrency-aware downstream resources). When false, the project is limited to baseline multicurrency behavior and attempts to set `multicurrency_enabled=true` on the project are rejected.

currency_status.description: Confirmation lifecycle state of the project currency. `pending` until a user explicitly confirms the currency; `confirmed` afterwards, at which point `currency_iso_code` can no longer be changed. Display, exchange-rate override, and multicurrency settings remain editable after confirmation. Conditionally present — absent from the response unless the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company or project.

confirmed_at.description: When the project currency was confirmed. Null while `currency_status` is `pending`. Conditionally present — absent from the response unless the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company or project.

confirmed_by.description: Procore user ID of the user who confirmed the project currency. Null while `currency_status` is `pending`. Conditionally present — absent from the response unless the currency-confirmation feature is enabled for the company or project.

parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

source.description: Where the record type originated: ASSETS (manually defined) or DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT (imported).

applies_to.description: Attachment origins this record type applies to.

items.description: Attachment origins this record type applies to.

source_type_stale.description: For source-added (e.g. DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT) record types, true when the linked source type is no longer active in the source tool, so the admin should delete this row. Null when not applicable (ASSETS-sourced) or when the source could not be checked.

display_order.description: Admin-configured position of this record type within its company list.

created_by.description: Contact Information

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore project whose exchange rates are being queried or modified. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/projects.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: When true, includes inactive (soft-deleted) exchange rates in the response alongside active ones. Defaults to false (only active rates returned). Useful for audit views and managing rate lifecycle. The string values "true" and "false" are coerced to Boolean by the controller.

get.description: Returns the collection of project-level exchange rates. By default only active rates are returned; pass `include_inactive=true` to also include inactive rates (useful for audit views). Returns an empty array when no rates have been configured.

schema.title: Project Exchange Rates
schema.description: Collection of exchange rates configured at the project level. Each rate quotes how many units of `quote_currency_iso_code` equal one unit of `base_currency_iso_code` (the project's currency).

x-changelog.summary: Group-managed memberships are protected from deletion
x-changelog.description:
When the Groups feature is enabled, deleting a Project Membership that is
managed by Groups now returns `422 Unprocessable Entity` with a structured
error (`code: MEMBERSHIP_GROUP_MANAGED`, `hint: group_managed`) instead of
deleting the membership. Behavior is unchanged when the feature is off.

x-changelog.description:
When the Groups feature is enabled, Bulk Remove no longer deletes
memberships managed by Groups. They are reported in a new `skipped_managed`
object (`code`, `reason_code`, `message`, `party_ids`) in the response and
excluded from `processed_ids`. Behavior is unchanged when the feature is
off.

put.description: Updates an existing project naming rule. Use isActive=false to deactivate without deleting.

parameters.name: rule_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the naming rule.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

schema.description: Request to update a field rule (definition + metadata)

rule_type.description: Optional metadata. NOT updatable: if provided, must match the existing rule's type; the server rejects mismatches.

fieldset_id.description: New fieldset id. FIELD_DEFAULTS only; ignored / rejected for NAMING. Provided to recover a rule whose asset type's fieldset has been changed by an admin. Must match the asset type's current fieldset and must contain the rule's trigger_field.

definition.description: Rule definition. Shape must match the rule's stored type — for NAMING, supply expression_fields; for FIELD_DEFAULTS, supply actions. Sent as a raw JSON object; the server converts it to the correct subtype and runs explicit validation. Omit entirely to update only metadata (e.g. is_active toggles).

is_active.description: Whether the rule is active. Set to false to deactivate.

conditions.description: Conditions AST for a conditional-validation rule

root.description: Root node of the recursive conditions tree

id.description: Unique identifier of the field rule

company_id.description: Company this rule belongs to

project_id.description: Project this rule applies to; null for company-level rules

asset_type_id.description: Asset type this rule applies to. Populated for FIELD_DEFAULTS; null for NAMING.

fieldset_id.description: Fieldset scope. '-1' for Procore default fields, external configurable fieldset id for custom fields. Null for NAMING.

rule_type.description: Kind of rule

trigger_field.description: Field that triggers this rule (e.g. asset_code for NAMING, custom_field_1234 for FIELD_DEFAULTS)

definition.description: Structured rule definition. Shape depends on ruleType: FieldRuleDefinitionDTO for NAMING, FieldDefaultsDefinitionDTO for FIELD_DEFAULTS, ConditionalValidationDefinitionDTO for MANDATORY/WARNING.

items.description: Expression segment for naming rule

value.description: For LITERAL: static text value

field.description: For REF: field identifier from Constants.NAMING_FIELDS (e.g. project, asset_type_id)

fallback.description: For REF: fallback when field value is null or empty

skip_if_empty.description: For REF: when true, omit this segment (and collapse delimiters) if the resolved value is empty instead of using fallback. Mutually exclusive with fallback. Default false.

dedupe_parent_segments.description: For REF parent_asset_id only: when true, enable ancestor segment de-duplication by dropping other REF segments whose values are already represented in the parent asset ID. Default false.

digits.description: For SEQ: number of digits for padding (e.g. 3 -> 001)

start_value.description: For SEQ: optional starting sequence number

post.description:
Create a new Project in a Procore account. The new project is active by default.

#### Country and State codes
The `country_code` and `state_code` parameter values must conform to the ISO-3166 Alpha-2 specification.
See [Working with Country Codes](/documentation/country-codes) for additional information.
#### Recommendation
For accounts creating a significant number of projects (more than 300),  schedule these operations during non-business hours (5 P.M PST - 7 A.M PST) to optimize efficiency. Coordinate the timing with your solution architect for insights into system load and effective resource utilization.

x-changelog.summary: Decode HTML-encoded markup in project name on create
x-changelog.description:
POST /projects now decodes HTML-encoded markup in `name`
(`<Project Name>`) and then strips tags, matching update.
Create already stripped raw HTML tags. A name that is only markup is
still rejected with 422 `can't be blank`. Previously encoded markup was
stored as literal text and could index as an empty string in the
Projects List. Names with no markup are unchanged.

x-changelog.summary: Require Concept Projects availability to create a Concept-stage project
x-changelog.description: Creating a project in the Concept stage now requires the Concept Projects feature to be available for the company (the concept-projects.milestone-1 flag is on OR the company holds the portfolio_management entitlement). When neither is true the request returns 422 Unprocessable Entity. Non-Concept project creation is unaffected.

x-changelog.summary: Add creation_source field to Create Project
x-changelog.description:
Adds a nullable `creation_source` field to the response.

Values: `mfe_single`, `mfe_bulk`, `api_single`, `api_bulk`, `erp_import`,
`api_sync`, `internal_other`. The value is computed server-side from the
inbound request; it is not accepted as a request parameter.

x-changelog.summary: Return proper validation error for invalid active param on project create
x-changelog.description: The POST /projects endpoint now returns a 400 Bad Request with a clear error message when the active parameter contains an invalid value (e.g., a random string). Previously, invalid values were silently accepted.

x-changelog.summary: Add field length validation for project_number
x-changelog.description:
Added validation to prevent StringDataRightTruncation errors when creating or updating
projects. The project_number field now has a maximum length of 255 characters.

When this field exceeds 255 characters, the API will now return a 422 Unprocessable Entity
response with a descriptive error message instead of a 500 Internal Server Error.

x-changelog.summary: Add validation for erp_integrated parameter
x-changelog.description:
Added validation for the erp_integrated parameter in project creation endpoint.
Valid values are: true, false, "true", "false", "1", "0".
Invalid values now return a 400 Bad Request error instead of 500 Internal Server Error.

x-changelog.summary: Enhanced Project Creation Authorization
x-changelog.description: Improved project creation authorization to support concept projects with granular permissions. The API now properly validates permissions for creating concept projects based on project stage and user permissions.

x-changelog.summary: Add inbound_email_address Field to Create Project
x-changelog.description: adds field inbound_email_address with full email address to response

x-changelog.description: Introduce the 'enable_copy_of_standard_cost_codes' parameter to facilitate the copying of default standard cost codes during project creation

patch.description:
Create or update a batch of projects.
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

#### Country and State codes
The `country_code` and `state_code` parameter values must conform to the ISO-3166 Alpha-2 specification.
See [Working with Country Codes](/documentation/country-codes) for additional information.
#### Recommendation
Please be advised to not use the sync endpoint for bulk project creation due to potential performance bottlenecks.

x-changelog.summary: Add creation_source field to Show Project
x-changelog.description:
Adds a nullable `creation_source` field to the response.

Values: `mfe_single`, `mfe_bulk`, `api_single`, `api_bulk`, `erp_import`,
`api_sync`, `internal_other`. Older projects may return `null` because this
value was not tracked when those projects were created.

x-changelog.summary: Enforce company_id parameter and Procore-Company-Id header validation on GET and PATCH project endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The GET /projects/{id} and PATCH /projects/{id} endpoints now properly validate that the
company_id query parameter or Procore-Company-Id header (if provided) matches the project's
actual company. Previously, these parameters were ignored and projects could be retrieved or
updated using any company_id where the user had access. Now, if a company_id is specified
(via query parameter or header) that does not match the project's company, the API will
return a 404 Not Found response. When both query parameter and header are provided, the
query parameter takes precedence. This change improves API consistency and security by
ensuring the company_id parameter and header are respected as filters.

x-changelog.summary: Strip HTML and HTML-encoded markup from project name on update
x-changelog.description:
PATCH /projects/{id} (and PUT, which hits the same action) now strips HTML
tags from `name` and decodes HTML-encoded markup (`<Project Name>`)
before stripping. A name that is only markup is rejected with 422
`can't be blank`. Previously that markup was stored and then indexed as
an empty string, so the project appeared nameless in the Projects List.
Names with no markup are unchanged.

x-changelog.summary: Add portfolio_program_uuid to project create, update, bulk, and sync payloads
x-changelog.description: Project write payloads now accept optional `portfolio_program_uuid`, the public UUID of the Portfolio Program the Project is placed under (distinct from the legacy `program_id` grouping). Null means unassigned. When the company does not have Portfolio Programs, the parameter is ignored and the rest of the payload still saves. Invalid placements are rejected with reason codes `PLACEMENT_STALE`, `PLACEMENT_FORBIDDEN`, or `PROJECT_LOCKED`. Bulk create and sync fail the affected row rather than the whole request.

x-changelog.summary: Standardize manual coordinate actor fallback behavior
x-changelog.description: Project update flows that create manual latitude/longitude history now align with company-scoped actor formatting behavior in downstream change history responses, including fallback to Unknown when name resolution is unavailable.

x-changelog.summary: Capture coordinate and department updates in project change history
x-changelog.description: The project update endpoints now record Active History entries for manual latitude/longitude changes and department updates, ensuring these updates appear in project admin change history responses.

x-changelog.summary: Add creation_source field to Update Project
x-changelog.description:
Adds a nullable `creation_source` field to the response.

Values: `mfe_single`, `mfe_bulk`, `api_single`, `api_bulk`, `erp_import`,
`api_sync`, `internal_other`. Older projects may return `null` because this
value was not tracked when those projects were created. The
`creation_source` value reflects how the project was originally created and
is not modified by updates.

x-changelog.summary: Return proper validation error for invalid active param on project update
x-changelog.description: The PATCH /projects/{id} endpoint now returns a 400 Bad Request with a clear error message when the active parameter contains an invalid value (e.g., a random string). Previously, invalid values were silently accepted.

x-changelog.summary: Add field length validation for project_number
x-changelog.description:
Added validation to prevent StringDataRightTruncation errors when creating or updating
projects. The project_number field now has a maximum length of 255 characters.

When this field exceeds 255 characters, the API will now return a 422 Unprocessable Entity
response with a descriptive error message instead of a 500 Internal Server Error.

x-changelog.summary: Enforce company_id parameter and Procore-Company-Id header validation on GET and PATCH project endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The GET /projects/{id} and PATCH /projects/{id} endpoints now properly validate that the
company_id query parameter or Procore-Company-Id header (if provided) matches the project's
actual company. Previously, these parameters were ignored and projects could be retrieved or
updated using any company_id where the user had access. Now, if a company_id is specified
(via query parameter or header) that does not match the project's company, the API will
return a 404 Not Found response. When both query parameter and header are provided, the
query parameter takes precedence. This change improves API consistency and security by
ensuring the company_id parameter and header are respected as filters.

x-changelog.summary: Add inbound_email_address Field to Update Project
x-changelog.description: adds field inbound_email_address with full email address to response

x-changelog.summary: Add latitude, longitude, override_start_date, and override_end_date fields to Update Project

x-changelog.summary: Add override_start_date_check and override_end_date_check in project parameters
x-changelog.description: Add override_start_date_check and override_end_date_check parameters to enable the use of the fields override_start_date and override_end_date

x-changelog.summary: Exclude enable_copy_of_standard_cost_codes in update project
x-changelog.description: Excludes the 'enable_copy_of_standard_cost_codes' parameter during project update

x-changelog.description:
When creating or updating a project with incorrectly formatted department_ids 
(e.g., string instead of array), the API now returns a 422 Unprocessable Entity 
with a descriptive error message instead of a 500 Internal Server Error.

x-changelog.summary: Allow Home tool admins to update persistent_message fields
x-changelog.description:
Users with Admin permissions on the Project Home tool can now update the 
persistent_message and persistent_message_title fields via the projects update 
endpoint, even if they don't have Project Admin tool permissions. These users 
are restricted to updating only these message fields and cannot modify other 
project fields.

get.description:
Return a list of active Projects.

If the authenticated user has full company admin permissions the request will return all of the projects in the company. If the user does not have full company admin permissions, the request will only return the projects that the user has been added to.
The default pagination is 100 projects per page. The max page size is 300 projects due to the size of the data in the response.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[category_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) assigned to the specified Punch Item Category ID(s). Pass the literal value 'none' to return uncategorized Punch Items (those with no Category assigned); 'none' may be combined with Category IDs to return both in a single request. Retrieve the available Category IDs from the Punch Item Category filter options endpoint.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort the returned Punch Items by. Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter, for example sort=name for A-Z or sort=-created_at for newest first. Sorting by category_name orders by the assigned Category name; uncategorized Punch Items sort together as a single group.

parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[closed_at][]

parameters.name: filters[created_at][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) created within the specified range. Supply as a two-element array of ISO 8601 date or datetime strings: the range start followed by the range end (e.g. `filters[created_at][]=2026-01-01&filters[created_at][]=2026-01-31`).

parameters.name: filters[date_notified][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) whose assignees were notified within the specified range. Supply as a two-element array of ISO 8601 date or datetime strings: the range start followed by the range end (e.g. `filters[date_notified][]=2026-01-01&filters[date_notified][]=2026-01-31`).

parameters.name: filters[due_date][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with a due date within the specified range. Supply as a two-element array of ISO 8601 date strings: the range start followed by the range end (e.g. `filters[due_date][]=2026-01-01&filters[due_date][]=2026-01-31`). x-changelog.summary: Filter Punch Items by custom status
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports filtering by punch item custom status using the
filters[custom_status_id] parameter, which accepts a single id or an array of ids
(e.g. filters[custom_status_id][]=10&filters[custom_status_id][]=20). Ids come from the
Punch Item Custom Status Filter Options endpoint. Filtering by a company default status
returns items resolved to that status whether or not the item carries the id explicitly.

x-changelog.summary: Added custom_status to Punch Item responses
x-changelog.description:

name, default, is_active, legacy_workflow_status, and the global status it rolls up to as
global_status. The flattened list representation (view=flatten_v0) also carries
custom_status_id. The value is resolved, so an item

for the item's workflow_status. Both are null for companies without the Punch Item custom
statuses feature enabled. The existing status and workflow_status fields are unchanged.

List Deleted (recycle bin) endpoints.

x-changelog.description:
The Recycle Bin endpoint now supports filtering by custom fields using the filters[custom_field_{id}] parameter.
Supports scalar values (boolean, decimal, string) and array values (lov_entries, login_informations) with OR logic.
Example: filters[custom_field_100]=true or filters[custom_field_200][]=10&filters[custom_field_200][]=20

x-changelog.summary: Add comprehensive sorting support to Recycle Bin endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The Recycle Bin endpoint now supports sorting by 18 fields using the sort parameter.
Supported fields: id, position, name, due, created_at, closed_at, description, priority, workflow_status,
location_name, punch_item_type_name, reference, status_text, trade_name, closed_by, created_by, final_approver, punch_item_manager.
Use sort=field for ascending or sort=-field for descending order.
Example: sort=name (A-Z) or sort=-created_at (newest first)

Change Event Line Item information is only returned if a line item is associated to a change event line item and user can view change events.

Note: A v2.0 version of this endpoint is available and recommended for new integrations. Use the Commitment Contract Line Items endpoint GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/commitment_contracts/{commitment_contract_id}/line_items.

`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date

`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/purchase_order_contracts/%7Bid%7D?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

delete.summary: Deletes a purchase order and optionally its resources.
delete.description:
This endpoint performs a soft delete of a purchase order. The deletion follows these rules:
1. If deleteResources is false: Only deletes the document if there are no connected documents
2. If deleteResources is true: Deletes both document and resources if there are no connected documents or resources
3. The deletion is performed as a soft delete (sets deleted = true)

parameters.description: The GUID of the purchase order to delete

get.description:
This endpoint checks if a purchase order can be safely deleted by examining:
1. Documents directly connected to this purchase order
2. Resources within this purchase order that are connected to other documents
3. Document is not a commitment.
If connected documents are found, only those are returned (rule #1).
If no connected documents but connected resources are found, those are returned with their connected documents.

parameters.description: The Id of the purchase order to verify for deletion

patch.summary: Updates a single receipt line item.
patch.description:
This endpoint allows updating properties (such as date, quantity, status, and location) for a specific receipt line item.
The receipt must not be in a Final state, except when voiding.
Set `void` to true to void the line item (quantity to 0). A note may be supplied on the same request.
Voiding requires a Final receipt, admin access, and the materials_management_void-enabled feature flag.
If the input is invalid or the line item doesn't exist, a 400 Bad Request response is returned.

requestBody.description: A Core.Models.Receipts.ReceiptLineUpdate object containing the properties to update.

delete.description:
This endpoint performs a deletion of a Receipt Line Item. The deletion follows these rules:
1. If locked is false: Only then Deletion can be performed as in that case it is a draft Receipt
2. The hard deletion is performed for the specified receipt line.
3. The hard deletion is performed for the connected shipment and shipment lines only if shipment is system generated.
4. The Shipment will be deleted only if there are no shipment lines connected to it. Otherwise only the related shipment line will be deleted.
5. The refdoc_related_id is marked as null in the receipt if the line being deleted is the only line in the receipt.

patch.description:
This endpoint allows updating various receipt header properties including status, signature,
received by name, received at timestamp, shipment reference, delivery location, and related document associations.
It also supports adding, updating, and removing dynamic properties.
When transitioning a receipt to Final status for a PO that originates from a commitment (order_type_id == 2),
an invoice (requisition) will be created in Procore for the received quantities.
Set `void` to true to void the receipt header and all associated lines. A note may be supplied on the same request.
Voiding requires admin access and the materials_management_void-enabled feature flag.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the receipt to update.

value.description:
Value rules:

- TEXT: Any string
- BOOLEAN: "true" / "false"
- DATE: "YYYY-MM-DD" (e.g. "2026-03-02"). Send null or "" to clear.
- NUMBER: Numeric string (e.g. "42", "3.14"). Stored as-is.
- LOCATION: Any string (e.g. a location name or ID)
- HIDDEN: Any string
- PERSON: A valid long user/person ID as string (e.g. "12345"). Send null, "", or "0" to clear.

Use this when receiving specific line items that are already tracked in another document.

item_id.description: Material catalog item ID to create a receipt line from.

items.description:

Use this when receiving items that are not yet associated with a shipment or purchase order.

delete.summary: Deletes a condition from a receipt line item and adjusts line quantities.
delete.description:
Deletes a specific condition from a receipt line item and adjusts the line quantity based on the condition type:
- Overage conditions: reduce the line quantity (overage is subtracted from the main line quantity).
- Shortage conditions: increase the line quantity (shortage is added back to the main line quantity).
- Other conditions: the deleted quantity is added to the primary condition.
The receipt must not be in a Final state for conditions to be deleted.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":256754,\"contract_id\":392745,\"rfq_response\":{\"comment\":\"This quote needs to be revised. See attached files.\",\"prostore_file_ids\":[3453247,6543893,3476145]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/rfqs/%7Brfq_id%7D/responses/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description:
Return only compliance documents in the given statuses. Repeat the parameter to filter on more than one status. Omit it to return documents in every status.

Example usage:

        ?status[]=not_compliant&status[]=in_review&status[]=revision_needed

Documents still stored under a legacy status are matched by the current equivalent — `not_compliant` also returns `not_submitted` documents, `in_review` also returns `review_pending`, `revision_needed` also returns `revise_and_resubmit`, and `compliant` also returns `approved`. The legacy values themselves are not accepted as filter values.

A value outside the enum returns `400 Bad Request`.

x-changelog.summary: Add allow_vendor_submission field to invoice compliance documents
x-changelog.description: The `allow_vendor_submission` field is now included in all API responses for invoice compliance documents (list, show, create, update). It can also be passed in both create and update requests. When the vendor submission feature flag is enabled, commitment admins can toggle this field to control whether vendors can submit compliance documents.

x-changelog.summary: Add status and allow_vendor_submission filters to the invoice compliance documents list endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The list endpoint now accepts optional `status[]` and `allow_vendor_submission` query parameters, which can be used on their own or together.
`status[]` may be repeated to match several statuses, for example `?status[]=not_compliant&status[]=in_review&status[]=revision_needed`.
Documents still stored under a legacy status are matched by the current equivalent, so `compliant` also returns documents stored as `approved`.
A status outside the documented list returns a 400.
Omitting the parameters preserves the existing unfiltered behavior.

get.summary: List Requisition Line Item Payment Application Associations
get.description:
Returns the owner Payment Applications that each line item of a requisition (subcontractor
invoice) was prefilled into.

Prefill v2 associations are line-item-exact: `line_item_id` is the requisition line item
(Billings Progress) id. Legacy (prefill_version != 2) associations are only known at the
requisition level and are returned with a `null` `line_item_id`, one row per associated
Payment Application.

Access mirrors the requisition line items permission: a user without commitment view receives
a 403. Payment Applications the user cannot view (prime contract permission) are omitted, so a
user with commitment view but no prime contract access receives an empty array.

(prefill_version != 2) associations, which are only known at the requisition level.

for legacy associations.

The requisition item id (of `item_type`) the line item belongs to. `null` for legacy
associations. Together with `item_type` this correlates to the line items endpoint's

x-changelog.description: Added an is_last filter. Setting this to true will return only the last requisition for each contract. Setting this to false will return all requisitions except the last one.

x-changelog.summary: Added header_only view
x-changelog.description: Added a new `header_only` view value to the `view` query parameter. When specified, the response includes the default header fields plus `action_policy`, `tax_summary`, `accounting_method`, and — for `progressive` contracts only — `summary_text`. The `items` and `item_packages` collections are intentionally omitted. This view is intended for split header / line-items rendering, where the SOV line items are fetched separately.

x-changelog.summary: summary_text is now gated on progressive contracts in the extended view
x-changelog.description: The `summary_text` field is now only included in the response when the contract's invoicing method is `progressive`. This applies to both the `extended` and `header_only` views. Previously, the `extended` view always included `summary_text` regardless of invoicing method. Callers that relied on `summary_text` being present for `simplified` contracts in the `extended` view should update accordingly.

x-changelog.summary: Added subtiers_certified_by to the response
x-changelog.description: Added `subtiers_certified_by` to the response as an object containing the certifier's id, login, name, and company_name when a requisition has been certified as having no sub-tiers.

x-changelog.summary: Added contract_invoicing_method to the response.
x-changelog.description: Creation of new response field contract_invoicing_method, that will tell if the contract invoicing method is progressive or simplified.

x-changelog.summary: Notice of General Availability
x-changelog.description: This endpoint is now generally available (GA).

x-changelog.summary: previous_requisition_id is now populated for Simplified Invoicing invoices
x-changelog.description: `previous_requisition_id` was always `null` for invoices whose `contract_invoicing_method` is `simplified`, because Simplified Invoicing does not store an invoice chain. It is now resolved as the non-deleted invoice on the same commitment that immediately precedes this one (`null` for the first invoice on the commitment). The field, its type and its nullability are unchanged; only the value for Simplified Invoicing invoices changes, and the field was never functional for them. Simplified Invoicing is not generally available, so no existing integration is affected. Progressive invoices are unaffected.

x-changelog.summary: Added header_only view
x-changelog.description: Added a new `header_only` view value to the `view` query parameter. When specified, the response includes the default header fields plus `action_policy`, `tax_summary`, `accounting_method`, and — for `progressive` contracts only — `summary_text`. The `items` and `item_packages` collections are intentionally omitted. This view is intended for split header / line-items rendering, where the SOV line items are fetched separately.

x-changelog.summary: summary_text is now gated on progressive contracts in the extended view
x-changelog.description: The `summary_text` field is now only included in the response when the contract's invoicing method is `progressive`. This applies to both the `extended` and `header_only` views. Previously, the `extended` view always included `summary_text` regardless of invoicing method. Callers that relied on `summary_text` being present for `simplified` contracts in the `extended` view should update accordingly.

x-changelog.summary: Added contract_invoicing_method to the response.
x-changelog.description: Creation of new response field contract_invoicing_method, that will tell if the contract invoicing method is progressive or simplified.

x-changelog.summary: previous_requisition_id is now populated for Simplified Invoicing invoices
x-changelog.description: `previous_requisition_id` was always `null` for invoices whose `contract_invoicing_method` is `simplified`, because Simplified Invoicing does not store an invoice chain. It is now resolved as the non-deleted invoice on the same commitment that immediately precedes this one (`null` for the first invoice on the commitment). The field, its type and its nullability are unchanged; only the value for Simplified Invoicing invoices changes, and the field was never functional for them. Simplified Invoicing is not generally available, so no existing integration is affected. Progressive invoices are unaffected.

When specified, the response includes the default header fields plus `action_policy`, `tax_summary`, `accounting_method`, and — for `progressive` contracts only — `summary_text`. x-changelog.description: The `summary_text` field is now only included in the response when the contract's invoicing method is `progressive`. This applies to both the `extended` and `header_only` views. Previously, the `extended` view always included `summary_text` regardless of invoicing method. Callers that relied on `summary_text` being present for `simplified` contracts in the `extended` view should update accordingly.
